sloka: तिष्ठ इति राजा चुक्रोष याहि याहि इति राघवः ।सुमन्त्रस्य बभूव आत्मा चक्रयोः इव च अन्तरा ॥२-४०-४६॥
transliteration: tiṣṭha iti rājā cukroṣa yāhi yāhi iti rāghavaḥ ।sumantrasya babhūva ātmā cakrayoḥ iva ca antarā ॥2-40-46॥

translations.english: The king cried, 'Stay, Stay', while Rama said 'Go on, Go on'. Sumantra's mind was caught as if in between two wheels.
